title: Australian Pavlova Bake
description: A malty, velvety Australian dessert made with low-glycemic-friendly ingredients and a crispy salt-bake crust.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond meal, coconut sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Add the apple cider vinegar and coconut oil to the egg whites, and continue whipping until well combined.
Add the vanilla extract and mix well.
Fold the egg mixture into the almond meal mixture until well combined.
Spoon the mixture onto the prepared baking sheet and shape into a round, even layer.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the edges are crispy and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Top with flaked coconut and fresh berries.
